sentences.en: Methods Urethroplasty was performed for penile hypospadias using inner preputial skin grafts combined with preputial island flap.

sentences.en: Conclusion The technique of one-stage urethroplasty by using perineal and preputial island flaps is the one of best choices for hypospadias.
